description: NaMnCrF₆ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P321 space group. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-56°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.43 Å. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to six F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent MnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-52°. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (1.96 Å) Cr-F bond lengths. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form CrF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnF₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 47°. All Cr-F bond lengths are 1.95 Å. Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CrF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent CrF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-56°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.19 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Mn atom.
